messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: inference-proxy.service latency > 600ms (p95) — page fired for oncall rotation
jess: acked. I'm on it.
jess: checking dashboards + traces
alex: pinged, can help if we need to scale proxies
incident-bot: autosilence applied (threshold: 3 spikes in 2m)
maya: I see a tiny spike in region-us-west, 1m avg p95 ~ 650ms, no errors, looks like a KV warmup pattern?
leo: no 5xxs in logs, traffic steady. any recent deploys?
infra-bot: deploys.pipeline: no recent deploys to inference-proxy in last 30m
jess: running quick query: curl -s 'https://observability/api/metrics?p=proxy.p95&range=5m' | jq '.values[-1]'
jess: response shows single sharp bump then back down.
alex: sounds like the short-lived prefill we've seen — KV prefill/eviction spike. can you check cache fill metrics?
maya: kv-metrics: prefill-rate spiked for ~10s then normalized, matches the timing
jess: no customer-facing errors reported in support, no spike in error rates. looks transient.
alex: recommend we let autosilence do its thing but keep trace sampling high for 5m in case it recurs
jess: agreed. raising trace sampling to 100% for 5m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page auto-resolved by alert policy (no sustained breaches)
jess: marking as no-impact for now. I'll leave notes in incident tracker and follow-up if it repeats.
alex: if this repeats we can enable short-lived rate-limiter on prefix-warmup and throttle prefill bursts.
maya: adding an eval in Redwood Optimize to detect this transient prefill pattern and suggest config changes.
leo: thanks — I'll subscribe to the watchlist for the next 2 hours.
infra-bot: note: autosilence window applied — 2m (policy now suppressing identical alerts within window)
jess: handoff to night oncall in 20m, updating rotation status and watchlist.
leo: copied, on radar.
incident-bot: thread closed.
